نختنق (form VIII)
# نَخْتَنِقُ (naḵtaniqu) /nax.ta.ni.qu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِخْتَنَقَ (iḵtanaqa)
# نَخْتَنِقَ (naḵtaniqa) /nax.ta.ni.qa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِخْتَنَقَ (iḵtanaqa)
# نَخْتَنِقْ (naḵtaniq) /nax.ta.niq/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِخْتَنَقَ (iḵtanaqa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
